'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Shumaker LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Shumaker]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
